explication: Call.md is an Electron meeting assistant: users authenticate and prepare a meeting, record and transcribe calls, receive live AI coaching and tool results, then review summaries and export or send meeting data to workflows. The graph follows the documented product capabilities and sampled renderer, IPC, LLM, and MCP behavior; unsampled subsystem wiring is shown only where the README describes it.
